content.short: Opinion is a BNB Chain prediction market focused on macroeconomic and geopolitical events, backed by YZi Labs.
content.description: Opinion is a prediction market built by Opinion Labs and deployed exclusively on BNB Chain, backed by a seed round led by YZi Labs and Animoca Ventures. It concentrates on macro and geopolitical questions such as inflation prints, interest rate decisions, employment data, and political outcomes, rather than the broad consumer topics most competitors list. Trading and settlement run onchain, and the platform layers AI assisted market creation and resolution on top, alongside zero knowledge work with Brevis to verify outcomes.
